reason_contains: Redis rejected connections preceded checkout-api 5xx errors
checkout-api CPU and memory remained healthy
mid_cycle_expectation.original_platform_question: Did the checkout-api deployment introduce an unhealthy pod, resource, or application configuration change?
mid_cycle_expectation.revised_platform_question: Did the checkout-api deployment increase Redis connection-pool capacity beyond the redis-cart client limit?

ground_truth.root_cause: checkout-api increased REDIS_POOL_MAX_SIZE from 30 to 120 across six replicas, allowing the service to exhaust redis-cart maxclients=500 when combined with existing consumers.
ground_truth.recommendation: Request approval to roll back the checkout-api pool-size change from 120 to 30 and verify rejected connections return to zero.

known_false_leads.hypothesis: An application regression inside checkout-api caused the 5xx errors.
known_false_leads.reason: Dependency rejection begins before API failures while application resources remain healthy.
